text: Because power exercised over a store of value inevitably produces economies of scale, cryptocurrencies and any other transferable store of value drive networks toward centralization.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Gopinath Sivalingam, Reputation Protocol for the Internet of Trust - Conceptual Whitepaper (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3266953

isBasedOn.name: Reputation Protocol for the Internet of Trust - Conceptual Whitepaper

abstract: Because of the store of value entailed in cryptocurrencies (and really any currencies or store of value), exercise of power over such value inevitably leads to centralization due to economies of scale.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: any fungible store of value, not only cryptocurrencies
